description:
Use this when the user wants to get a part made: packages the fabrication files into one directory plus a zip, and returns links to public instant-quote pages. Pass { file | code } and output_dir; optional name (default 'part'), formats (default step, stl, 3mf, pdf-drawing, bom-csv; add 'dxf' for flat or sheet parts), and processes ('3d-print' | 'cnc' | 'sheet-cut') to filter the links. Each file is written by the export tool, so its gates apply; a format that fails is reported in files[] and the rest still ship. Also writes manifest.json and README.txt. quote_links lists JLC3DP, JLCCNC, PCBWay, Xometry, SendCutSend and Craftcloud with the pack file to upload to each. These are plain web pages: nothing is uploaded or ordered. The user opens the link and uploads the file. Run dfm_review first if you have not.
Hosted server: pack files are written on the kernelCAD server and returned in downloads[].url; nothing is uploaded to a fabrication service.

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

formats.description: Files to include. Default step, stl, 3mf, pdf-drawing, bom-csv.

output_dir.description: Directory to write the pack into (created if missing). Hosted server: only the directory name is used; the pack is written in a server-owned directory and returned as download links.

processes.description: Only return quote links for these processes. Default: all.

name: fab_pack
title: Package Fabrication Files
